jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer II - Europe
jobs.desc: Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. Â WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many âfirstsâ. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitorâ¦) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs â¦) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, youâll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY The Senior DevOps Engineer II operates beyond individual feature ownership and takes responsibility for major infrastructure subsystems, multi-cycle initiatives, and complex technical challenges that impact multiple teams. This role works closely with Engineering Managers, software engineering, Security, and fellow infrastructure engineers to drive scalable, reliable, and secure platform solutions and is expected to clarify ambiguous problems, lead technical design efforts, and elevate engineering standards across the Infrastructure pillar. Success in this role is measured not only by the delivery of high-quality systems but also by the ability to create technical leverage, strengthen reliability, and increase the organization's execution capacity. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Â Be accountable for the technical health, scalability, and long-term sustainability of a defined infrastructure domain or platform area. Lead complex, multi-cycle infrastructure initiatives with end-to-end ownership â from problem framing and architecture design through to measurable delivery and stabilization. Design robust, scalable, and resilient infrastructure architectures and implementation plans that reduce operational risk and improve platform performance. Break down ambiguous or loosely defined infrastructure challenges into clear technical strategies with explicit trade-offs, and communicate these effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product, and cross-functional teams to align infrastructure work with business priorities and engineering roadmaps. Improve platform reliability by proactively identifying systemic risks, technical debt, and architectural bottlenecks within the domain and drive remediation before they impact teams or customers. Contribute hands-on to infrastructure code and configuration, delivering high-quality, secure, well-structured, and maintainable work (Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, platform automation). Contribute to the evolution of CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code practices, and platform automation standards, pushing for improvements that benefit teams beyond your immediate scope. Apply and advocate for cloud infrastructure best practices (primarily AWS), covering cost efficiency, scalability, security compliance, and operational excellence across your domain. Partner with software engineering, security, and QA teams to ensure infrastructure considerations are embedded early in the development lifecycle and architectural decisions. Drive security posture improvements within your domain using cloud security and vulnerability management tools (such as Aikido), moving the team from reactive remediation toward proactive risk reduction. Improve monitoring, observability, and incident response practices within your domain â contributing to better detection, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation. Raise engineering standards through thoughtful code and design reviews, documentation, and technical guidance. Mentor mid-level and senior engineers across the Infrastructure pillar, supporting their growth toward greater technical ownership. Support production stability by actively participating in debugging, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation efforts. Act as a technical reference point within a defined infrastructure domain, fostering alignment and reducing cross-team friction. Demonstrate AI literacy by actively applying AI tools to improve infrastructure workflows and drive measurable productivity gains across the team. Â EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 9+ years of relevant experience as a DevOps, Infrastructure, or Site Reliability Engineer, with demonstrated ownership of complex systems or subsystems. Proven experience designing and operating large-scale applications on AWS (GCP or Azure a plus). Strong expertise with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, including reusable modules, state management, and governance patterns. Experience designing secure, scalable CI/CD pipelines and release automation for production-grade systems (e.g. GitHub actions) Experience leading technical initiatives, platform migrations, or large refactors across teams is highly valued. Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, including compute platforms such as ECS, EKS, Fargate, Lambda or equivalents. Strong Linux fundamentals, networking, and fluency in scripting languages such as Bash, Ruby, Python, or Go. Experience with PostgreSQL operations and familiarity with caching and queueing systems such as Redis or Sidekiq. Strong experience with observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), SLOs, and incident response practices. Proven ability to apply zero-downtime deployments, autoscaling, and capacity planning in production environments. Strong knowledge of security best practices, including IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, and vulnerability management. Hands-on experience with cloud security and vulnerability management platforms (such as Aikido, Snyk, or Wiz), including triage, remediation workflows, and integration into CI/CD. Familiarity with supporting modern AI/ML services or data-intensive workflows is desirable. Excellent knowledge of how to identify and fix performance bottlenecks across compute, storage, and network layers. AWS Certified DevOps Engineer â Professional (or equivalent) is a strong plus. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate effectively in complex, evolving environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a collaborative, remote-first setting. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. jobs.title: Manager EDI
jobs.desc: Hi, weâre Gravie. Our mission is to create health benefits that actually benefit small and midsize businesses and their employees. Our innovative benefit solutions and services are developed and delivered by a diverse group of unique people. We encourage you to be your authentic self - we like you that way. A Little More About The Role: Weâre looking for an Manager, EDI to own how Gravie exchanges eligibility, enrollment, and claims data with our partners and internal systems as our book of level-funded health plans grows. This leader will report to the Director of Configuration and will build and lead a team that configures, tests,and monitors these connections, while setting the standards that keep them accurate, secure, and scalable.. This role carries meaningful latitude to shape process, tooling, and team structure, and is expected to represent EDI in cross-functional forums. You Will: â Lead, develop, and scale a team of EDI analysts, including hiring, mentoring, performance management, and cross-training so no process depends on one person. â Own the EDI program, including standards for file specifications, mapping, naming, scheduling, and documentation, and maintain an inventory of every trading partner, file, and schedule with a clear owner for each. â Manage new trading partner setup from requirements through UAT and go-live, translating business needs from Product, Enrollment, Operations, and Finance into clear technical specifications. â Oversee daily monitoring of inbound and outbound X12 transactions (834, 837, 835, 278, and acknowledgments such as 999, TA1, and 277CA), and drive failures and rejects to root cause. â Establish error handling, alerting, reconciliation, and QA standards so issues are caught before members, providers, or groups are affected. â Own EDI trading partner, clearinghouse, and vendor relationships, including SLA performance and escalation resolution. â Manage off-cycle changes, renewals, and system upgrades without disrupting daily processing, and lead cross-functional planning for open enrollment and Q4. â Ensure all data exchange follows HIPAA, privacy, and security requirements, including secure transfer (SFTP and encryption), and partner with Security and Compliance on reviews and audits. â Help shape and drive the automation roadmap, evaluating tools and approaches (including APIs and connectivity platforms) that deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. â Build runbooks, documentation, and compliance practices that hold up under audit. â Provide visibility to leadership on volumes, error rates, turnaround times, risk, and capacity across EDI. â Act as the primary escalation point for complex, high-stakes EDI issues, exercising independent judgment to resolve risk before it reaches leadership. â Demonstrate commitment to our core competencies of being authentic, curious, creative, empathetic, and outcome oriented. You Bring: â 7+ years of healthcare EDI experience, including 2+ years leading a team in EDI, configuration, claims operations, or healthcare IT. â Deep working knowledge of HIPAA X12 transaction standards (834, 837, 835, 278) and acknowledgments, and how they integrate with enrollment, claims configuration, and adjudication. â Hands-on experience with file validation, mapping, and troubleshooting, including reading raw X12 and identifying loop and segment issues. â Experience in benefits administration, enrollment and eligibility, or claims processing, ideally in a TPA, payer, or carrier environment. â Experience managing trading partner onboarding, testing, and UAT, and working with clearinghouses or vendors against defined SLAs â Working knowledge of SFTP and secure file transfer practices. â Strong communication and cross-functional relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders. â Ability to operate strategically while remaining close enough to the details to guide the team through complex technical problems. â Ability to deal with ambiguity, shift gears comfortably, and take decisive action without having the total picture. â Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills, with the judgment to know what needs leadership visibility versus what the team should own. Extra credit: â Experience with EDI and integration tools â SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation. â Familiarity with API-based integrations, FHIR, or 270/271 transactions. â Experience supporting system integrations or large-scale platform migrations. â Previous experience in a startup or high-growth company environment. A Little More About Us: We know healthcare. Our company was founded and is still led by industry veterans who have started and grown several market-leading companies in the space. We have raised money from top tier investors who share the same long-term vision as we do of building an industry defining company that will endure over the long run. We are well capitalized. Our clients love us. Customer satisfaction rates among employees using Gravie health plans consistently rank above 80% â nearly 40 points above the industry average. Our culture is unique. We tend to be non-hierarchical, merit-driven, opinionated but kind people who thrive working in a high-performance, fast-paced environment. People at Gravie care deeply about making a positive impact in the lives of the people we serve. Benefits Our unique benefits program is the gravy, i.e., the special sauce that sets our compensation package apart. In addition to standard health and wellness benefits, Gravieâs package includes alternative medicine coverage, flexible PTO, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave, paid holidays, a 401k program, transportation perks, education reimbursement, and 2 days of paid paw-ternity leave. jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.desc: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. n8n sits at one of the most interesting UX problems in software right now: more than 80% of workflows built on n8n today involve AI agents, and the platform is in the middle of a deliberate expansion from deeply technical developers toward a broader set of builders. That tension, keeping power users happy while dramatically lowering the floor, is the central design challenge. This is a foundational hire with a real mandate and direct exec partnership. What you'll do Own the quality bar Set a clear, consistent quality bar that the team can orient around and build toward, so great work becomes the natural output of how we design together. Build review processes and critique rituals that give the team a shared language for quality and the confidence to make strong craft decisions together. Evolve the design system and QA practices so the bar rises as the team grows. Dig into one of the most genuinely interesting UX challenges in the space: n8n has historically had a steep learning curve for new users. Your job is to lower that floor without losing the power that experienced builders love. Drive design's strategic influence Shape product strategy, not just respond to it. Bring design thinking into roadmap conversations and help surface user problems before they become someone else's brief. Help lead n8n's expansion toward a broader, less technical audience, a deliberate and exciting strategic shift that design should be leading. Build the kind of relationships with Product, Engineering, and leadership where design is a genuine thought partner at every stage. Build and grow the team Lead a team of around 14 designers today: 2 Design Leads each working with ~6 ICs, plus Design Engineering and UX Research (with more hires ahead). Shape the team structure, career framework, and progression paths so people know where they stand and where they're going. Create a culture of high standards and honest feedback, where people feel supported to do their best work and have a clear sense of what great looks like. Own hiring and headcount planning for the department, and help us grow without losing what makes the team good. Build research into how we make decisions Establish a pragmatic, continuous research practice from the ground up. We're making our first dedicated UX research hires, so there's real room to shape this. Make customer insight, product data, and community feedback a live input to product decisions, so teams are building from evidence at every step. Connect research to the decisions that matter most: activation, adoption, retention, and helping new users find their way into n8n with confidence. Help the team work in new ways Champion practical AI adoption inside the design org, from prototyping and research synthesis to design QA and workflow efficiency. Help the team stay curious and current as the tools, patterns, and expectations around AI products continue to evolve fast. Model the kind of working style you want to see: thoughtful, adaptive, and genuinely excited about what's changing. Requirements Must-haves 🧭 Product design leadership: You have managed managers, coached senior designers, and built design teams that improve both craft and business outcomes, including making hard performance calls when needed. 🧩 Complex product systems experience: You have led design across complex or developer-facing products where UX quality depends on deep product understanding. 🎨 Craft authority: You are a quality bar, not just someone who appreciates quality. You can identify great work, explain why it's great, and hold the line on standards even when it's uncomfortable. 📣 Strategic influence, not just strategic thinking: You have made design a co-equal in product conversations, not a downstream function. You know how to bring people with you, create debate, and drive decisions. 🔀 Structured problem-solving under ambiguity: You find your way into unclear problems and create a plan. You don't just ask good questions, you answer them. You move forward when there's no map. 🤖 AI-era product judgment: You understand the AI, automation, or adjacent tooling landscape and can turn emerging patterns into usable, trustworthy product experiences. 🔍 Research literacy: You know how to build research into product development so insight becomes part of how teams make decisions, not a separate artifact. 📊 Data-informed decision making: You use product analytics, research, and customer evidence to guide decisions instead of relying on taste or opinion alone. 🧱 Org design and performance management: You can design team structures, define career paths, raise expectations, and handle difficult performance conversations with clarity. Nice-to-haves 🌱 Open-source or community product experience: You have worked on open-source, fair-code, community-led, or builder-driven products and understand what it means to design for a community that has strong opinions. 💻 Design engineering credibility: You have enough front-end or design engineering fluency to partner deeply on design system adoption and implementation quality. 🌍 Remote-first operating systems: You have built design rituals, critique, QA, and collaboration practices that work across distributed teams and time zones. 🚀 Growth surface experience: You have worked on activation, onboarding, templates, time-to-value, or product-led growth surfaces. ⬆️ Rising Design Manager profile: We are open to someone who has been an exceptional Design Manager and is ready for their first Head-level role, if the fundamentals are exceptional. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.
